# biznetgio_gpu_graph (Data Source)

Data monitoring graph NEO GPU (`GET /neo-gpus/accounts/{account_id}/graph-monitor`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_gpu_graph" "main" {
  account_id = 12345
  timeframe  = "day"
}

output "graph" {
  value = data.biznetgio_gpu_graph.main.graph
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) Account id GPU yang mau diambil graph-nya.

### Optional

- `timeframe` (String) Timeframe graph: `hour`, `day`, `week`, `month`, atau `year`. Default `hour`.

### Read-Only

- `graph` (String) Raw graph payload sebagai string (alias graph/data/payload/content).
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response.
